changeHypothesis.summary: Cement spot prices and industry profits were at historical highs, while Conch and Huaxin converted that cycle into exceptional earnings/cash flow and traded near 5.5x forward earnings. The problem is not whether profits are real, but whether peak conditions leave a fresh residual expectation gap while sector equities are already underperforming.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Supply discipline and regional concentration can support profits across seasons, but winter constraints and record prices create explicit normalization risk.
